jobs.title: Desenvolvedor Back End
Desenvolvedor Full Stack
jobs.description:
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Full Stack para integrar nosso time de tecnologia, atuando no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de aplicações web. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções completas, desde a construção de interfaces intuitivas até a implementação de APIs, regras de negócio e integração com bancos de dados.

Principais responsabilidades

* Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando tecnologias front-end e back-end.
* Criar e integrar APIs REST para comunicação entre sistemas.
* Desenvolver interfaces responsivas, intuitivas e acessíveis.
* Projetar, implementar e otimizar bancos de dados relacionais.
* Realizar testes, identificar e corrigir erros e garantir a qualidade do código.
* Participar de decisões técnicas e contribuir para a arquitetura das aplicações.
* Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de produto, design e tecnologia.
* Implementar melhorias de desempenho, segurança e escalabilidade nos sistemas.

Requisitos obrigatórios

* Experiência com desenvolvimento Full Stack.
* Conhecimento em HTML, CSS e JavaScript.
* Experiência com pelo menos uma tecnologia back-end, como Java, Node.js, PHP ou Python.
* Conhecimento em frameworks front-end, como React, Angular ou Vue.js.
* Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como MySQL ou PostgreSQL.
* Conhecimento em desenvolvimento e integração de APIs REST.
* Familiaridade com Git e controle de versão.
* Conhecimento em boas práticas de programação e arquitetura de software.

Diferenciais

* Experiência com Docker e ambientes de cloud computing.
* Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum ou Kanban.
* Experiência com CI/CD e automação de testes.
* Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações web.
* Experiência com inteligência artificial e integração de APIs de IA.

Competências comportamentais

* Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica.
* Proatividade e autonomia na resolução de problemas.
* Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.
* Organização e comprometimento com prazos.
* Interesse em aprender novas tecnologias e aprimorar continuamente suas habilidades.

Pagamento: R$3.600,00 - R$11.000,00 por mês

Local do trabalho: Remoto

jobs.title: Software Engineer Back End PL
jobs.description:
Somos a **Conexa**, ecossistema digital de saúde integral, líder na **América Latina**. Contamos com milhares de médicos, psicólogos, nutricionistas e enfermeiros que, por meio de nossa plataforma, conseguem cuidar de pacientes em qualquer lugar que eles estejam. Unimos pacientes, profissionais, empresas e operadoras com o objetivo de reduzir as ineficiências de custo e qualidade de atendimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.

Nascemos com o objetivo de democratizar o acesso à saúde de qualidade, e acreditamos que corpo e mente precisam ser tratados de forma integrada para que o paciente tenha uma vida saudável. Atualmente, realizamos mais de 400 mil consultas por mês, sendo 180 mil em saúde mental. Com o nosso modelo de negócios, conseguimos cobrir 24 milhões de vidas.

**Temos um time formado por pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e que acreditam em um futuro com mais saúde física e mental para todos!**

**Aviso importante!**

A **Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor** para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas **exclusivamente pela Gupy** e o processo de inscrição é **totalmente gratuito**. Caso receba qualquer pedido de pagamento ou oferta de vaga fora da Gupy, desconfie! Isso não faz parte da nossa prática de recrutamento.

 **Responsabilidades e atribuições**

**Principais responsabilidades:**

* Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e evoluir sistemas já existentes, com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.
* Ter domínio de arquitetura de software e capacidade de propor evoluções estruturais no sistema
* Implementar integrações entre serviços internos e externos (APIs, microsserviços, sistemas distribuídos).
* Escrever código limpo, testável e eficiente, seguindo boas práticas de engenharia e padrões definidos pela área.
* Criar e executar testes automatizados e unitários para garantir a qualidade das entregas.
* Atuar em conjunto com times de produto, QA, front end e dados, garantindo a entrega ponta a ponta.
* Participar ativamente de code reviews, contribuindo para o aprendizado coletivo e a manutenção de padrões técnicos.
* Monitorar e otimizar desempenho de aplicações, identificando e resolvendo gargalos.
* Documentar fluxos, arquiteturas e práticas adotadas, fortalecendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
* Colaborar em cerimônias ágeis (plannings, refinamentos, retrospectivas), trazendo postura propositiva e resolutiva.
* Apoiar desenvolvedores juniores.

  
**Requisitos e qualificações**

**Requisitos**

* Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento back end em Java.
* Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, MongoDB).
* Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e queries complexas/pesadas.
* Conhecimento em arquitetura de serviços modulares e APIs RESTful.
* Experiência com testes automatizados, versionamento (Git) e CI/CD.
* Conhecimento em ferramentas de IA para geração de código (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, entre outras).
* Atuação prévia em times de produto digital e metodologias ágeis.
* Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas complexos, com boa comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

**Diferenciais**

* Experiência em **healthtechs** ou empresas de grande complexidade técnica.
* Vivência com **AWS** (EC2, RDS, SQS, Beanstalk).
* Experiência prévia no desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando ferramentas de IA (Claude, Cursor, Codex, etc).
* Experiência em **observabilidade, monitoramento e boas práticas de SRE**.
* Atuação prévia em ambientes de **escala e alto volume de dados**.

  
**Informações adicionais**

**Benefícios Conexa:**

**Cartão** **CAJU**, crédito de R$ 1.059,00 ao mês distribuídos entre as categorias: Refeição, Alimentação, Mobilidade, Saúde, Home Office, Cultura e Educação;

**Plano de Saúde AMIL S450 – APTO**, com coparticipação de 30% sob consultas e exames e 40% PS; Extensível para dependentes Legais (cônjuges e/ou filhos até 24 anos) e os valores por dependente são descontados em Folha de Pagamento. Valor pro dependente: R$ 506,86 por vida + coparticipação.

**Omni Saúde:** Destinado à aquisição de medicamentos mediante prescrição médica. Saldo mensal de R$ 100,00 disponibilizado ao colaborador, exclusivamente para a compra de medicamentos prescritos pelo nosso Hospital Conexa.n

Acesso gratuito às plataformas **Conexa e Zenklub**, com consultas online para cuidar da sua saúde mental e física;

**Auxílio Creche** de acordo com a convenção coletiva regional e **Licença Maternidade/Paternidade Estendida** para a nossa equipe: oferecemos a opção de estender a licença maternidade para 6 meses. Para os papais, a licença paternidade é de 30 dias.

**Seguro de Vida** **SULAMERICA**: Sabe aquele ditado "viver sem medo"? Bem, é mais ou menos isso. Queremos que você se sinta seguro(a) sabendo que você e seus entes queridos estão protegidos, não importa o que aconteça.

**Day off no mês do aniversário:** Você merece um momentinho só seu para comemorar esse dia especial! Tire folga no mês do seu aniversário e celebre como quiser.

**Totalpass e Wellhub**: Para você se manter firme nos objetivos fitness.

**Desconto em Cursos:** Pensando no seu desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, a Conexa oferece parcerias educacionais com diversas instituições de ensino.

**Benefício SESC:** Acesso a atividades esportivas, cultura, lazer, cursos e muito mais com condições especiais para colaboradores e dependentes.

⁠ **Vale Transporte:** Desconto 6% do salário, caso seja optado.

  
  

Somos a **Conexa**, o maior ecossistema digital de saúde física e mental da **América Latina**. Contamos com milhares de médicos, psicólogos, nutricionistas e enfermeiros que, por meio de nossa plataforma, conseguem cuidar de pacientes em qualquer lugar que eles estejam. Unimos pacientes, profissionais, empresas e operadoras com o objetivo de reduzir as ineficiências de custo e qualidade de atendimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.

Nascemos com o objetivo de democratizar o acesso à saúde

jobs.title: Profissional Desenvolvedor FullStack Pleno
jobs.description:
A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa **global**.

Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade?

  

**Como Profissional de Desenvolvimento de Software você vai:**

* Desenvolver e manter componentes de software, aplicando boas práticas de codificação, testes e segurança.
* Identificar problemas, propor soluções e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura dos sistemas.
* Documentar processos e atuar com autonomia, inclusive em entregas complexas com múltiplas dependências.
* Monitorar o desempenho das aplicações, acompanhar tendências de mercado, seguir rigorosamente práticas de segurança e participar ativamente de treinamentos, demonstrando proatividade e espírito colaborativo.
* Entender a importância dos processos do time, além de conseguir já seguir todos os processos.
* Proporcionar treinamento de desenvolvimento (principalmente técnico) aos integrantes da equipe iniciante, conforme necessário.

  

**Para essa vaga, você deve ter:**

* Capacidade de estruturar soluções computacionais de forma lógica e eficiente.
* Conhecimento de versionamento de código.
* Familiaridade com boas práticas de metodologias ágeis, promovendo entregas contínuas e colaborativas.
* Aplicação de padrões de projeto, princípios de desenvolvimento limpo e compreensão do ciclo de vida de aplicações.
* Experiência com desenvolvimento frontend com React JS, MaterialUI, CSS, HTML
* Experiência com desenvolvimento backend com TypeScript, NodeJS, Python
* Experiência com banco de dados relacional e não relacional
* Experiência com Modelagem de Dados
* Experiência com API REST e GraphQL
* Ter conhecimentos em ferramentas CI/CD.
* Conhecimento de Arquitetura Modernas (Container, Microservicos, Microfrontend).
* Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software seguindo conceitos e boas práticas de código limpo e arquitetura limpa.

  

**É um diferencial se você tiver:**

* Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia ou áreas afins.
* Inglês intermediário para conversação.
* Experiência com desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Spec Driven Development)
* Experiência com pipelines de ingestão e processamento de dados
* Experiência em projetos no contexto de manufatura
* Experiência em projetos que envolvem sistemas regulados e auditáveis

  

**Benefícios:**

* Assistência Médica Nacional (para o titular e dependentes, com quarto privativo)
* Assistência odontológica nacional (para o titular e dependentes)
* Vale refeição / alimentação flexível
* Auxílio home office
* Day off (no mês do aniversário)
* Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
* Licença Maternidade (6 meses) e Paternidade (20 dias) estendidas
* Auxílio creche para filhos de até 3 anos (por filho)
* Apoio em saúde mental com a Wellz
* Clube de Vantagens com descontos em diversos parceiros
* Convênio com instituições de ensino e cursos de idioma
* Desenvolvimento Profissional (Universidade Corporativa)
* Parceria com empresa de coworkings no Brasil
* Programa de Qualidade de Vida e Bem-Estar
* Médico consultor para acompanhamento de radixers
* Planos de incentivos

  

**A Radix está sempre no topo das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar porque:**

* Temos profissionais comprometidos, dedicados, curiosos e inovadores.
* O espírito de equipe é a nossa maior força. Trabalhamos de forma cooperativa e sabemos que estamos juntos, remando na mesma direção.
* Temos um ambiente diverso, que valoriza equidade e inclusão.
* Nossa jornada de trabalho é flexível e em quase todos os projetos é possível trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
* Valorizamos o bem-estar e o cuidado com as nossas pessoas, com programas de apoio à saúde mental, psiquiatra e médico consultor disponíveis.

**Curtiu?**

  

**#VemPraRadix**

**Código da vaga: 5a2b**

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer – Quality & Test Automation [Remoto - Brasil]
jobs.description:
A **DBServices** é uma empresa que possui raízes profundas tanto em **Portugal** quanto no **Brasil**, refletindo uma ligação sólida entre os dois países.  
Em constante crescimento, a DBServices destaca-se por atender grandes empresas em Portugal, nos Estados Unidos e no Brasil, consolidando sua presença internacional e ampliando seu impacto no mercado global.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Engenheira de Plataforma Sênior com foco em Qualidade para integrar um time de plataforma de engenharia de qualidade no setor de varejo. Nessa posição, você vai habilitar os times de desenvolvimento a adotarem boas práticas de qualidade de software. Também será responsável pela arquitetura técnica do que entra no caminho crítico de execução de testes, garantindo que a experiência do desenvolvedor tenha a menor fricção possível.

  

**Atividades**

* Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de testes com base na pirâmide de testes, prevenindo e corrigindo a inversão da pirâmide
* Decidir o que entra no caminho crítico de execução, como suítes de PR, pipelines e quality gates
* Construir e manter a automação de testes para aplicações web, mobile e desktop de loja, incluindo simuladores de periféricos e a estratégia de device farm
* Desenhar e manter pipelines de teste com suítes de PR, quarentena de testes flaky, seleção de testes orientada a risco e testes sintéticos em produção (shift-right)
* Desenhar e manter bibliotecas de teste compartilhadas entre os times
* Definir estratégias de dados de teste e virtualização de serviços em conformidade com a RGPD (GDPR) e com os requisitos de dados de cartão
* Governar o uso de GenAI no fluxo de desenvolvimento e testes, e testar sistemas baseados em IA
* Conduzir a qualidade não funcional: segurança, privacidade, performance, resiliência e acessibilidade
* Habilitar e orientar os times em práticas de qualidade, definindo padrões e compartilhando conhecimento
  

**Requisitos**

* Experiência sênior em Quality Engineering / Automação de Testes, com mentalidade de plataforma e habilitação de times
* Domínio de arquitetura da pirâmide de testes, contract testing e correção de inversão da pirâmide
* Domínio de automação de testes para web, mobile e desktop, incluindo testabilidade (identificadores estáveis), simuladores de periféricos e matriz de device farm
* Experiência sólida com execução de testes em CI/CD: suítes de PR, quarentena de testes flaky, seleção orientada a risco e testes sintéticos em produção
* Sólida base em engenharia de software: linguagem da suíte de testes, Git, revisão de código, pair programming e desenho de bibliotecas compartilhadas
* Experiência prática com gestão de dados de teste (sintéticos, anonimizados e mascarados) e virtualização de dependências externas, considerando RGPD (GDPR) e dados de cartão
* Experiência prática com uso de GenAI no fluxo de desenvolvimento e governança de IA (catálogo de skills por gate, aprovações, rastreabilidade), além de testes de sistemas de IA (eval sets, regressão de prompt)
* Experiência prática com testes não funcionais: segurança (SAST), privacidade, testes de carga com perfis de pico de varejo, resiliência e acessibilidade
  

**Diferenciais**

* Mapeamento de capabilities e classificação por tiers de risco, com obrigações de teste por tier e capability coverage
* Especificação testável e práticas de shift-left: critérios de aceite testáveis, derivação de casos de teste antes do desenvolvimento, DoR/DoD e definição de camada de teste no refinamento
* Métricas de qualidade, como capability coverage, DDE (eficácia de detecção de defeitos) por fase, MTTD/MTTR e anti-métricas
* Ensino e facilitação: criação de trilhas de capacitação, double diamond, roadshows e comunidades de prática
* Influência e escrita de decisão: negociação de capacidade, escrita de ADRs e criação de definições que sobrevivem ao autor
  

**Na DBSPT você encontrará:**

* **Ambiente Colaborativo***:* Valorizamos o senso de comunidade, onde as ideias são compartilhadas e as conquistas celebradas em equipe.
* **Trabalhe de qualquer lugar:** Aproveite a liberdade e a flexibilidade para trabalhar onde se sentir mais produtivo e confortável.
* **Conexão Global:** Você terá a oportunidade de interagir com pessoas de diferentes países e culturas, expandindo sua rede de contatos e visão de mundo.
* **Apoio à Saúde Física:** Por meio do *Totalpass* e *Mediquo*, oferecemos recursos e programas focados no seu bem-estar físico.
* **Cuidado com a Saúde Mental:** O *Team Care* disponibiliza iniciativas e ações para apoiar seu equilíbrio emocional e mental no dia a dia.

  

**Why DBServices?**
-------------------

At **DBServices**, we **design**, **develop**, and **support** *cutting-edge digital platforms* that drive **innovation** for leading companies across **IT**, **Banking**, **Retail**, **Government**, **Healthcare**, and other industries in **Europe** and the **Americas**. Our **expertise** empowers businesses to **grow**, **adapt**, and **lead** in dynamic markets.

**Trusted** by industry leaders like **Worten**, **Sonae**, **Edenred**, **Natixis**, **Farfetch**, **Glintt**, **Efacec**, **Segurança Social**, and **McDonald's**, we deliver **solutions** that make a *real impact*.

**Join us** and be part of a **global team** that's shaping the future of **digital transformation**.

jobs.title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora FullStack Python e React Pleno
| Fullstack Developer (Java + Angular/React) | Mid-level
SR Backend Developer Java/Kotlin
jobs.description:
At Zallpy, technology is created by curious, collaborative people who care about doing things well. If you enjoy environments where there is room to ask questions, test ideas, learn, and grow together, this opportunity is for you!

At Zallpy, a diverse environment and an inclusive culture are part of who we are. We build a safe and respectful space where different perspectives are welcomed and everyone has the opportunity to grow, contribute, and belong.

We support your development at every stage of your journey.  
Come grow with us.

We are looking for someone to join a team that thinks big, works with attention to detail, values partnership in everyday work, and shares responsibility. We believe in autonomy, the exchange of different experiences, and building solutions together.

Here, growing means sharing knowledge, respecting different ways of thinking, and building relationships based on trust while delivering high-quality technology.

If this way of working resonates with you, come join us.

  

**What you will do:**

* Develop and evolve backend tools in Kotlin and Java to import, transform, validate, and export interface models.
* Design model-to-model and model-to-text transformations between different interface formats.
* Implement JSON serialization and deserialization driven by schemas, with strong validation and versioning.
* Structure and maintain multi-module Gradle builds, keeping modules, dependencies, and releases organized.
* Write automated tests and keep the tooling reliable and well documented.
* Collaborate with the language and web teams so the models fit the editor and the API Studio platform.
* Take part in technical decisions, code reviews, and continuous improvements to architecture and quality.

**What we are looking for:**

* Solid, senior-level experience with Kotlin and Java.
* Experience with multi-module Gradle builds.
* Hands-on experience with model transformation: converting, mapping, or generating structured models (e.g., metamodels, ASTs, schemas, or domain models).
* Experience with schema-aware JSON serialization (e.g., JSON Schema, kotlinx.serialization, Jackson with schema validation).
* Good knowledge of Git and engineering best practices: code review, continuous integration, and automated testing.
* Advanced English for daily communication with an international client.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Franca IDL or other interface definition languages (e.g., Protobuf, gRPC, OpenAPI).
* Automotive communication protocols and standards: SOME/IP, CAN, LIN, FlexRay, AUTOSAR, PDU, ARXML.
* Automotive tools and libraries such as vsomeip, CommonAPI, DBC files, Vector (CANoe, CANdb++, DaVinci), ETAS, or dSPACE.
* Xtext, EMF, or other language and modeling frameworks.
* Experience building code generators, parsers, or converters between technical formats.

**Where you will work:**

* This is a 100% remote position.

**Hiring models:**

* CLT.
* Cooperative.

**Benefits of being a Zallper:**

Meal/Food Allowance  
Caju multi-benefit card (credit format), offering flexibility for everyday needs. (CLT only) \*

Health Plan – Unimed  
No waiting period or copayment for the holder. Possibility to include dependents (children, spouse, or stepchildren) with copayment. (CLT only) \*

Dental Plan – Uniodonto  
Affordable options to include dependents. (CLT only) \*

Wellhub  
Access to gyms, physical activities, and wellness programs.

Zenklub  
For CLT: Two free sessions per month and special rates for additional sessions.  
For Cooperative/Contractor: Special rates for sessions.

Life Insurance

jobs.title: Sr Kubernetes Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Remote

  

We are the movers of the world and the makers of the future. We get up every day, roll up our sleeves and build a better world - together. At Ford, we’re all a part of something bigger than ourselves. Are you ready to change the way the world moves?

Join a team building an enterprise-grade private cloud platform from the ground up, treating on-premise and hybrid infrastructure as a scalable, living software product rather than a set of manually operated systems. This role goes beyond configuring platforms — the candidate will help build them, developing and scaling OpenShift/Kubernetes clusters end-to-end through GitOps practices.

The ideal candidate has a strong engineering (not purely operational) mindset, with hands-on coding and automation skills. This includes experience with GitOps tools (Argo CD, Github Actions, Tekton), Infrastructure as Code (YAML/IaC), Ansible playbooks, and proficiency in Go and/or Python (or a similar object-oriented systems language), along with API development experience. A deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, its components, and Operators is essential. The role blends platform engineering, infrastructure automation, and developer enablement, applying software engineering best practices to reliability, scalability, and self-service capabilities for application teams.

**What you'll do...**

* Design, build, architect, and maintain OpenShift/Kubernetes platforms for on-premise, bare-metal, and hybrid cloud environments, including virtualized (OpenShift Virtualization/OSV) and containerized workloads.
* Develop and support custom Kubernetes/OpenShift Operators, APIs, and developer tooling to enable seamless, self-service platform capabilities for application teams.
* Write clean, testable, and robust infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Go, Python, and Ansible to eliminate manual toil and drive the private cloud transformation.
* Implement and manage GitOps-based CI/CD deployment pipelines using tools such as Argo CD, Tekton (OpenShift Pipelines), GitHub, Helm, Kustomize, and related build tools.
* Enhance platform reliability through monitoring, alerting, observability, and automated recovery/self-healing mechanisms, applying a software-driven SRE approach (including auto-scaling and disaster recovery automation).
* Build and integrate observability solutions and dashboards using Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace/AppDynamics, and logging platforms (ELK/Splunk).
* Support distributed systems, microservices, API gateways, and service mesh (e.g., Istio) architectures, including secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault) and Zero-Trust security models.
* Explore and integrate emerging capabilities such as AI/ML pipelines (e.g., Vertex AI) and chaos engineering into private cloud operations.
* Collaborate closely with architects and application teams to improve platform usability, share ideas, and tackle platform constraints.
* Mentor team members (junior and senior developers), champion coding standards, and promote best practices in software craftsmanship, platform engineering, and GitOps workflows.

**You'll have...**

* 6+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or DevSecOps, with a strong automation and software development skillset (engineering mindset, not purely operational).
  + Deep, hands-on expertise with Kubernetes/OpenShift (OCP) platform administration and internals — cluster builds, upgrades, and integrations — implemented entirely through code, scripts, and automation (not manual/GUI-driven).
  + Strong object-oriented programming background with demonstrated development skills in Go and/or Python (or a similar systems language); comfortable as a hands-on developer/individual contributor.
  + Practical experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling (e.g., GitHub, Argo CD/OpenShift GitOps, Tekton/OpenShift Pipelines).
  + Hands-on experience with API development, integration, and an "API-first" mindset.
  + Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and infrastructure automation.
  + Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native design principles.
  + Experience with Kubernetes Operators and custom controllers.

**Even better, you may have...**

* Experience with OpenShift internals such as Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM), MachineConfig, Multus CNI, Trident, Ceph, and OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF).
* Experience with OpenShift Virtualization for running mixed container and VM workloads.
* Experience with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio) and API gateways.
* Experience with observability and analytics tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics), including writing custom exporters/dashboards.
* Experience with storage solutions (Ceph, ODF) and secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault).
* Exposure to hybrid cloud or private cloud environments, bare-metal/VMware infrastructure, and Zero-Trust security models.
* Familiarity with additional developer pipeline tools such as SonarQube, Maven, Polyrepo/Monorepo workflows.
* Interest or experience integrating AI/ML platforms (e.g., Vertex AI) and chaos engineering into infrastructure operations.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Card Loan Platform)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Card Loan Platform team builds the high-throughput decision engine at the heart of Affirm's card products. Unlike traditional cards, every pay-later transaction is backed by its own unique loan, and our system is the "invisible piping" that makes this complex model work at scale. Every swipe triggers our platform to solve a hard problem in milliseconds: matching messy, fragmented payment network data to the correct loan to drive real-time approvals, origination, and refunds.

As Affirm experiences explosive growth, our team's contributions are a key enabler. This isn't just another backend role; you'll be building the "financial brain" for our flagship card products, with your work on the critical path for every single swipe. We're tackling a unique, high-stakes distributed systems challenge that demands exceptional correctness and massive scale. You will partner closely with product, data science, and engineering teams to design and build the future of our industry-leading money movement platform.

If you are passionate about making foundational design decisions and building a beloved, lasting financial brand—come join us. It's going to be an amazing ride!

**What you'll do**

* Drive technical strategy by leading the planning, prioritization, and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with product, technical, and business goals.
* Lead the end-to-end system design and development of large-scale, high-availability services. This includes building robust APIs and data models for our micro-service and event-driven architectures.
* Collaborate across functions with partners in Product, Analytics, Design, Legal, and Accounting and to define requirements and execute our card loan attribution and lifecycle strategy.
* Ensure system health and performance by analyzing and troubleshooting complex technical issues, optimizing existing code, and driving solutions that focus on long-term robustness and scalability.
* Mentor and grow the team by guiding junior engineers, leading technical discussions and design reviews, and championing best practices through code review.

* 5+ years of experience in software development or engineering, with a deep understanding of system design and architecture.
* Motivated leader, inspiring team growth and fostering a culture of continuous learning
* Excellent communicator, adept at sharing complex ideas with diverse audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a creative and solution-oriented mindset.
* Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Kotlin, or similar.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL), web frameworks, and RESTful API development.

Description

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior C++ Software Engineer to join our Network Management Service (NMS) team, focused on building and evolving the cross-platform delegate component that powers device discovery and network insight across distributed environments. The component operates close to the network and interacts directly with customer devices using a variety of network management and system protocols. You will design and implement software that performs device discovery, collects and processes network data, executes monitoring workflows, and communicates with network infrastructure at scale.

This is a systems-oriented C++ role. You will work with asynchronous operations, concurrent communication, platform-specific APIs, and performance-sensitive code running on both Windows and Linux. The codebase is primarily C++ and Qt, with native platform-specific implementations where required.

Collaborating closely with backend, UI, QA and product teams, you will help shape reliable, scalable solutions that deliver deep visibility into customer networks. If you are an experienced C++ engineer who enjoys working on systems-level challenges, network protocols, distributed architectures, and performance-critical applications, this is an opportunity to make a direct impact on a rapidly growing platform.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, NJ, NC, NY, OH, OR, TN, TX, VA, and WA. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.

Onsite interviews may be required for this role.

We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on Java, Kotlin, C++, Golang and Postgres; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in AWS. Knowing large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client-server architecture will help you.

What You’ll be Doing

Cross-Platform Development: Build and maintain software for Windows and Linux using C++ and Qt, with native platform-specific implementations where appropriate. This may involve Windows APIs, POSIX, networking APIs, and other OS-specific facilities.
Network Discovery and Monitoring: Design and implement features for discovering network devices, collecting device and interface information, and monitoring network health.
Network Protocols: Work with protocols such as SNMP, SSH, ICMP, WMI, and other network and device management protocols. Implement and troubleshoot protocol interactions and handle the differences between vendors and devices.
Systems Programming: Develop high-performance, concurrent C++ software that runs close to the network and communicates with potentially thousands of devices.
Performance and Reliability: Design asynchronous workflows, optimize resource usage, and ensure reliability under large numbers of concurrent network operations.
Testing Ownership: Design and implement unit, integration, and system-level tests. Make testability and quality an integral part of the development process.
Technical Collaboration: Work with backend, UI, QA, and product teams to define requirements and design solutions that work reliably across different operating systems, network environments, and device vendors.
Troubleshooting: Investigate complex issues involving C++, operating systems, network protocols, customer environments, and interactions between multiple components of the NMS platform.
Other Duties as needed

About You

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical field
7+ years of C++ development experience, with proficiency in C++ 14 or newer
Strong understanding of modern C++ and experience writing production-quality, maintainable systems software.
Proficiency working with Qt and CMake
Experience developing for Windows, Linux/POSIX and cross-platform environments.
Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and asynchronous programming.
Experience with network programming and network protocols. Knowledge of SNMP is particularly valuable.
Familiarity with protocols and technologies such as SNMP, SSH, ICMP, WMI, or similar network/system-management technologies.
Experience in debugging and diagnosing problems across application, operating-system, and network layers.
Ability to develop comprehensive test cases and test plans, ensuring thorough coverage of all functional requirements
Comfortable working on complex systems where behavior depends on operating system, network, and device-specific characteristics.
Collaboration with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements
Experience working with highly critical systems

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

At Ro, we believe that when people achieve their health goals, they can achieve their life goals. The highest-leverage way to move society forward is to give people their health, and the current healthcare system isn’t built to do that. It was built to bill, not to serve patients.

We’re building a new system. One where the patient is in control. One designed from scratch for the digital age.

At Ro, technology isn’t just a function… It's core to how we deliver care .
We’ve built a vertically integrated healthcare platform that connects telehealth, diagnostics, pharmacy, and logistics into a seamless, end-to-end experience for millions of patients.

…and we’re just getting started.

As part of Tech @ Ro , you’ll work on systems that operate at scale, with an opportunity to:

Solve complex, high-concurrency problems across a full-stack platform
Build and ship quickly with tight feedback loops and real-world impact
Own systems end-to-end, from architecture to production performance
Work alongside experienced operators, technical leaders, and clinicians
Help define how modern healthcare should be delivered

We’re a performance-driven team with a strong sense of ownership and urgency. We move fast, learn quickly, and hold a high bar for what we build, and do so with a big heart — because patients depend on it.

If you’re motivated by impact, scale, and the chance to help lead the patient revolution, come build with us.

The Role

As a Staff Software Engineer/Tech Lead on our Patient Experience team, you’ll serve as a technical and architectural leader for the systems that help patients discover, start, and continue their care with Ro. You'll be responsible for the patient-facing platform that supports patients taking the first steps in their patient journey - and the second, and the tenth, and the 100th. Rather than building one-off experiments, you’ll design the architecture and technical foundations that allow us to continuously iterate on and personalize intake for patients as we learn more about their needs. You’ll serve as a strong technical partner to our Growth and Clinical teams, helping translate patient and business needs into thoughtful, scalable technical solutions. Patient Experience operates across a highly visible and interconnected part of the patient journey, partnering closely with engineering, product, design, and data to translate complex clinical information across systems into clear, intuitive next steps for patients. You’ll bring the systems thinking and technical leadership needed to connect decisions across domains, translate shared goals into cohesive, scalable patient experiences, drive patient and growth outcomes, and raise the team’s architectural and technical bar.

What You’ll Do

Translate patient and growth opportunities into technical strategy, partnering with product and engineering to determine how systems should evolve to support the outcomes we’re trying to achieve.
Lead complex, backend-oriented engineering work across healthcare intake and prescription flows, commerce, merchandising, subscriptions, renewals, and related patient experiences.
Shape ambiguous problems from the earliest stages, bringing systems thinking and technical judgment into product decisions rather than engaging only once requirements have been defined.
Elevate the team’s technical and product thinking, helping engineers reason about both the systems underneath an experience and the patient and business outcomes those systems enable.
Build the systems and foundations that enable the team to move faster over time, creating reusable capabilities that make it easier to rapidly test, iterate on, and scale new patient and growth experiences as Ro continues to evolve the future of healthcare.
Develop a deep understanding of Ro’s business and patient journey, and translate those insights into high-impact technical opportunities that improve patient outcomes and drive revenue and growth.

What You’ll Bring To The Team

Strong technical judgment and a track record of impact, demonstrated through the scope and complexity of problems you’ve led.
Deeply outcome-oriented and naturally curious, with a track record of measuring impact, learning from results, and continuously finding ways to improve both the product and how you work.
Deep backend and systems design expertise, with the ability to reason across services, APIs, data flows, dependencies, and architectural boundaries.
Strong product judgment, with a demonstrated ability to connect technical and architectural decisions to patient, growth, and business outcomes.
Experience leading technical work for consumer-facing growth experiences, such as acquisition, onboarding, conversion, merchandising, subscriptions, retention, or renewal.
A track record of leading architecture across complex, interconnected systems, partnering effectively with other engineering teams and influencing technical direction across organizational boundaries.
The ability to move fluidly between product and systems thinking, understanding the patient experience while reasoning deeply about the architecture that enables it.
Comfort operating in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, creating clarity, navigating tradeoffs, and driving complex technical work forward.
Experience with healthcare, commerce, or another regulated or data-sensitive domain is a plus.

jobs.description:
Description

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior C++ Software Engineer to join our Network Management Service (NMS) team, focused on building and evolving the cross-platform delegate component that powers device discovery and network insight across distributed environments. The component operates close to the network and interacts directly with customer devices using a variety of network management and system protocols. You will design and implement software that performs device discovery, collects and processes network data, executes monitoring workflows, and communicates with network infrastructure at scale.

This is a systems-oriented C++ role. You will work with asynchronous operations, concurrent communication, platform-specific APIs, and performance-sensitive code running on both Windows and Linux. The codebase is primarily C++ and Qt, with native platform-specific implementations where required.

Collaborating closely with backend, UI, QA and product teams, you will help shape reliable, scalable solutions that deliver deep visibility into customer networks. If you are an experienced C++ engineer who enjoys working on systems-level challenges, network protocols, distributed architectures, and performance-critical applications, this is an opportunity to make a direct impact on a rapidly growing platform.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, NJ, NC, NY, OH, OR, TN, TX, VA, and WA. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.

Onsite interviews may be required for this role.

We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on Java, Kotlin, C++, Golang and Postgres; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in AWS. Knowing large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client-server architecture will help you.

What You’ll be Doing

Cross-Platform Development: Build and maintain software for Windows and Linux using C++ and Qt, with native platform-specific implementations where appropriate. This may involve Windows APIs, POSIX, networking APIs, and other OS-specific facilities.
Network Discovery and Monitoring: Design and implement features for discovering network devices, collecting device and interface information, and monitoring network health.
Network Protocols: Work with protocols such as SNMP, SSH, ICMP, WMI, and other network and device management protocols. Implement and troubleshoot protocol interactions and handle the differences between vendors and devices.
Systems Programming: Develop high-performance, concurrent C++ software that runs close to the network and communicates with potentially thousands of devices.

Experience in debugging and diagnosing problems across application, operating-system, and network layers.
Ability to develop comprehensive test cases and test plans, ensuring thorough coverage of all functional requirements

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to develop our core libraries for Agentic Applications. Are you excited by the prospect of building foundational technology that powers the next generation of agents? Have you ever dreamed of elevating engineering practices to enable the safe and scalable deployment of autonomous systems? As a global leader in AI and deep learning, NVIDIA is redefining industries and our work in agentic computing is at the forefront of this revolution. Join us in building the scalable agentic capabilities, reusable building blocks, and high-quality libraries that will accelerate developer productivity, ensure agent quality, and provide critical acceleration and optimization for highly performant and efficient agents. Work directly with a community of creative engineers and collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in the world of autonomous agents!

What You'll Be Doing

Track and understand evolving agent development patterns across NVIDIA and the broader ecosystem, maintaining current knowledge of both research and commercial products.
Develop open-source libraries and tools which accelerate and optimize agent harnesses and frameworks ensuring top-tier performance, accuracy, quality, and stability.
Benchmark the latest agents to identify bottlenecks and build creative solutions to increase performance, reduce cost, and improve latency.
Work closely with teams building high-performance data pipelines, RAG systems, vector databases, and GPU-optimized training and inference workflows to deliver best-in-class agentic applications.
Identify gaps and friction in current agent architectures, and translate insights into agentic tools that boosts developer velocity and agent quality—backed by evaluations, benchmarking, and feedback loops.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years experience in at least one of Rust, Python, Go, or Node.js, with working familiarity in at least one more.
Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, callbacks, request lifecycles, and event-driven systems.
Hands-on experience with evolving agent architectures, multiple agents frameworks and agent harnesses.
Proficiency in LLM applications, agent workflows, tool calls, and model-provider APIs.
Ability to design or extend cross-language APIs with attention to consistency, usability, stability, and backwards compatibility.
Systems-level debugging and performance intuition: able to trace execution from high-level API calls through runtime internals, language bindings, callbacks, serialization, and event emission to understand overhead and optimize hot paths.
Strong interpersonal skills, enabling direct contact and effective collaboration with the open source community.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience building evaluation/benchmarking systems for agent workflows (metrics, regression, feedback loops).
Rust systems work, especially async Rust, Tokio, serde, API design, or runtime state management and /or Python native extension experience with PyO3, maturin, or Python/Rust bindings.
Instrumenting third-party frameworks without changing user-visible behavior. Knowledge of OpenTelemetry, tracing, structured events, exporters, or observability pipelines are a plus.
Middleware, plugin systems, guardrails, policy engines, or request/response interception and maintaining open-source libraries, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.
Profiling or optimizing runtime/library overhead across language boundaries, async execution, native bindings, serialization, tracing, or middleware pipelines.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer, Integrations
jobs.description:
Remote, US

About Nametag

Nametag helps companies verify the real person behind high-risk workforce actions, from account recovery to identity checks, before attackers can exploit the gap.

Deepfakes, social engineering, and stolen credentials have made "who is actually on the other side of this request?" a critical infrastructure problem. We are building the identity verification and account protection layer companies use to answer that question quickly, securely, and with less friction for real users.

The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to build the integrations that put Nametag inside the systems our customers already use.

Nametag is rarely the application someone opens. It's the identity check that happens inside a helpdesk ticket, an HR onboarding flow, or a Slack message from someone claiming to be the CFO. Our reach is determined by how well we embed into Workday, ServiceNow, Slack, Okta, ICIMS, UKG, and the long tail behind them — and that embedding is engineering work.

This is a full stack role with an unusual center of gravity. You'll write backend services and APIs on our side, configuration and setup experiences in our console, and the connector code that talks to a dozen platforms that each made different decisions about authentication, extensibility, and what a webhook means. You'll join a dedicated team whose purpose is expanding Nametag into new systems and new use cases.

What makes this work interesting is that you're building into environments you don't control and can't change. Every target platform has its own auth model, its own rate limits, its own review process, and its own idea of how much UI you're allowed. Workday's extensibility surface is narrow and governed. Slack gives you modals and Block Kit, which were not designed for identity verification. ServiceNow gives you enough rope to break a customer's upgrade path. Designing something that is secure, usable, and actually buildable inside those limits — and that keeps working when the vendor ships a change you didn't ask for — is the core of the job.

The breadth is real. You'll be reading someone else's API documentation most weeks, and debugging behavior that documentation doesn't describe. Engineers who like going deep on one system for a year will be unhappy here. Engineers who like landing in an unfamiliar platform and having it figured out by Thursday will do well.

You'll work closely with the product manager for integrations, who owns how each integration should work, and you'll have real influence over that design because you're the one who knows what the platform will actually permit.

What You'll Do

Build integrations end to end

Design and build connectors into third-party enterprise platforms: authentication, data flow, event handling, and the verification experience inside the host application.

Build the Nametag-side APIs, services, and webhooks each integration depends on.

Build the console configuration and setup experience customers use to install and operate the integration.

Take integrations through marketplace and app review processes, including the requirements that gate a listing.

Work across unfamiliar platforms

Get productive fast in APIs and extensibility models you haven't seen before, and develop real expertise in the ones that matter most.

Implement against OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and whatever a given platform does instead of those.

Handle the operational reality of depending on other people's systems: rate limits, partial outages, breaking changes, and undocumented behavior.

Own reliability across the fleet

Operate what you build. Integrations fail in production in ways that are specific to one customer's configuration, and you'll be the one who figures out why.

Build the observability that makes a broken integration visible to us before it's visible to the customer.

Design for versioning and backwards compatibility. Customers do not upgrade on your schedule.

Make each one faster than the last

Factor shared infrastructure out of individual connectors so common patterns stop being rebuilt.

Contribute to the tooling, scaffolding, and templates that shorten time to first working integration.

Document how each integration works well enough that support and solutions engineers can operate without you.

What We're Looking For

Work authorization required: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship.

You do not need to match every bullet. We care most about breadth, pragmatism, and comfort working against systems you don't control.

4+ years building and operating production software, including backend services and APIs.
Demonstrated experience integrating with third-party APIs in production — not a one-off script, but something you owned and kept running.
Strong backend skills in Go, Node.js, Python, Java, or similar, plus enough frontend ability to build configuration and setup UI in React or a comparable framework.
Working knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, webhooks, and the failure modes each brings.
Relational database experience, PostgreSQL preferred.
Cloud experience, AWS preferred.
The temperament for integration work: patience with other people's documentation, and the instinct to verify rather than trust it.
Clear communication and good judgment in a remote, cross-functional team.

Bonus Points

Hands-on experience with Workday, ServiceNow, Slack, Okta, Entra, ICIMS, or UKG extensibility specifically.
Experience shipping an app through a marketplace or app review process.
Experience with identity, authentication, account recovery, fraud prevention, or compliance-heavy products.
Experience building an integration platform or connector framework rather than individual integrations.
Experience in a solutions engineering, professional services, or customer-facing engineering role.

What We Value

High ownership.
You see what needs doing and do it.
Technical judgment.
You make systems simpler, safer, and easier to operate.
Speed with care.
We move quickly because attackers move quickly, but we do not cut corners on trust or security.
Kindness and integrity.
Trust starts with how we work with each other.

Culture and Benefits

Nametag is a remote-first team with regular in-person time to stay connected.

jobs.title: AgentCore Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Appnovation is a global, full-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience & Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities.

We’re hiring AgentCore Platform Engineers to build the agent-facing layer of the platform. That covers how agents run, remember and work together, and how they safely reach the internal systems the business already runs on. Each engineer will have a main focus in one of the two areas below and work closely across both. What you build becomes the template other teams copy, so quality and clarity matter as much as speed. This is a named-team engagement, so the person we propose is the person who starts.

We know production experience with Bedrock AgentCore is rare. We care more about strong AWS fundamentals and real hands-on work with agent frameworks than about whether you’ve used AgentCore by name. If that’s you, please apply.

FOCUS AREAS

Agent Runtime & Orchestration: Build runtime patterns, memory strategies, orchestration and multi-agent handoffs, and the reference implementations other teams copy.
Gateway, Tools & Integrations: Turn internal APIs, Lambdas and legacy systems into governed tools through AgentCore Gateway, including MCP server development.

Role Responsibilities

Runtime Patterns: Define how agents are structured, packaged and run on AgentCore Runtime, including sessions, state, error handling and timeouts.
Memory Strategies: Design short-term and long-term memory patterns using AgentCore Memory, and guide teams on when to use which.
Orchestration and Multi-Agent Handoffs: Build patterns for planning, tool use, supervisor/worker setups and handoffs between agents, with clear boundaries and fallbacks.
Tool Onboarding: Expose internal REST APIs, Lambda functions and legacy services as agent tools through AgentCore Gateway, using OpenAPI specs and Lambda targets.
MCP Server Development: Design and build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for systems that need custom integration, with clean tool definitions and schemas.
Governance and Access: Set up authentication and authorization for agents and tools (AgentCore Identity, OAuth, IAM) so agents only reach what they’re allowed to.
Legacy Integration: Work with system owners to wrap older or on-premises systems safely, handling rate limits, data mapping and error cases.
Reference Implementations and Standards: Build production-quality reference agents, starter kits and a repeatable process for adding, versioning and reviewing tools.
Evaluation and Guardrails: Build in evaluation, Bedrock Guardrails, contract tests and safety checks so agents and tools behave predictably before going live.
Enablement: Run walkthroughs, write docs and support the teams onboarding to the platform.

Qualifications

5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong Python (TypeScript is a plus).
Hands-on experience building LLM agents with at least one agent framework (e.g., Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, LlamaIndex).
Practical experience with LLM tool/function calling and handling model output.
Strong AWS fundamentals: IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, containers, DynamoDB/S3, VPC connectivity and Secrets Manager.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and OpenAPI specs, and auth patterns such as OAuth 2.0 and OIDC.
Understanding of agent memory, retrieval (RAG) and context management trade-offs.
Deep hands-on strength in at least one of the two focus areas, and working knowledge of the other.
Clean, well-tested code that other engineers will read and reuse.
Clear communication and comfortable teaching patterns to other teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity). A strong plus, but not required.
Experience building or running MCP servers in a real environment.
Experience with multi-agent systems in production, including observability and failure handling.
Experience integrating with enterprise or legacy systems, or with API management platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong).
Experience with LLM evaluation tools and approaches.
Experience in pharma, life sciences or another regulated industry with data access controls.

Who You Are

You’ve built agents that actually work, and you know where they tend to break
You care about patterns other people can copy, not just clever one-offs
You think about security and access control before anything goes live
You pick up new AWS services quickly and learn by building
You’re honest about what agents can and can’t do today
You work well inside a client team and enjoy helping other engineers succeed
You have prior experience in consulting
Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred

Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies! Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.

------------

Eterio Realities Inc. is a software company in Victoria, British Columbia, building augmented reality tools for industrial manufacturing. Our story began in 2010, out of challenges encountered during the construction of the Sparkling Hill Resort in Vernon, B.C.

Working closely with the UX team from Figma designs, you'll deliver customer-centric features, and you'll turn plain-language feature specifications into working software using AI-assisted development, with the review discipline to ship secure, high-quality code.

jobs.title: Back End Developer
jobs.description:
**Back End Developer**
======================

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------

Here's the corporate drivel HR made us put at the top: Acro Commerce is looking for a Back End Developer to build, integrate, and maintain high-quality commerce solutions for our clients.

That's done. Now here's what we really want. Someone who codes like it's their native tongue, but can still talk comfortably with our crew and the odd client. You've shipped real things, you've debugged other people's messes, and you'd rather pick up a new stack than say "that's not my language." You care about writing code that the next developer won't curse you for.

You also know yourself. You can tell when you're stuck, and you ask for help before the deadline, not after. You can walk us through a bug that humbled you, and what you learned, without flinching. Low ego, high skills. That's the combo.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As a Back End Developer, you'll build and maintain the systems that help manufacturers, distributors, and brands sell online. Our client work spans a range of platforms and languages, and our developers flex between them. Right now, we're seeing a growing amount of .NET work, so if you've got .NET experience, we especially want to hear from you.

***Build & Deliver***

* Write high-quality, maintainable code that follows Acro Commerce standards and our production process
* Build new features, integrations, and full builds, as well as updates and revisions to existing sites
* Juggle multiple smaller tasks or larger builds with shifting priorities, and still hit your deadlines

***Problem Solving***

* Find and fix problems in code that might not be yours, where your only hint is a cryptic complaint from a client
* Provide accurate estimates for defects, builds, and new functionality, and stick to them
* Deliver efficient, practical solutions to work requests, issues, and defects

***Collaboration & Growth***

* Communicate clearly with Project Managers, Tech Leads, and clients about work requests, problems, and defects
* Act as a peer and mentor to other developers, while being comfortable asking for help yourself
* Pick up new languages and platforms as client work demands it

**What You Bring**
------------------

We're less concerned with degrees and more with what you can actually build. Formal education is NOT required; you just need to show us you can code.

* Solid hands-on back-end development experience, with work samples you can share
* Experience with .NET / C# is a strong asset
* Experience with some of what we work with day-to-day: PHP, Drupal, JavaScript, TypeScript, NodeJS, React, NextJS, Shopify, WordPress, AWS, Docker, Lando, Kubernetes, Acumatica
* Know other languages? Tell us. If you're a badass Lisp hacker type, mention that too.
* Comfort in a Linux shell for day-to-day tasks, plus some understanding of Linux hosting (bonus points if you've set up your own server, even if nobody else cared)
* Source control experience (Git, GitHub, etc.)
* An excellent internet connection and hardware that can survive an hour-long conference call
* Fluency in English

If you've built something you're proud of and can show it, we want to see it.

**What We Bring**
-----------------

*All offers of employment with Acro Commerce are contingent on successfully completing a criminal background check.*

* **A team you'll actually like.** We take the work seriously and ourselves a lot less. Expect the occasional virtual happy hour, team competition, or reward for no particular reason. Fair warning: there are costumes. Check out our site and dissect how we do what we do.
* **Ownership and impact.** We aren't going to stick you in a corner with headphones on and call you "the IT department." Developers own this joint, and we get it. Your compensation package gets tailored to your location, experience, and your fit with our values, with hourly rates starting between $40 and $60 CAD.
* **Autonomy over your schedule.** Flexible start times, earned days off, and real remote work. Prefer to start at 8:00? 9:00? We'll work with you. Want every second Friday off? We've got a program for that. Work from your home office or from our Kelowna HQ- your call. *(Some client contracts require staff to be located in Canada, so most positions need you to be legally able to work here.)*
* **Professional development:** We might live and breathe *software* development, but we are also really passionate about our team's *personal* development, too. We love to learn and are always striving to be the best version of ourselves; whether it's training on the latest technology or learning how to become a better delegator, we will help you improve your skills and hit your goals.

All careers come with a 30-day no-questions-asked money-back guarantee. If you are in any way unsatisfied with your career, we will return you to the workforce at absolutely NO COST to you (minus shipping and handling).

jobs.description:
About Pinecone

Pinecone is the trusted AI knowledge company. Its trusted AI knowledge platform—including its Database, Nexus, and Marketplace products—power accurate, fast, and cost-effective AI applications for more than 10,000 customers and 1M developers worldwide. Pinecone's mission is to make AI knowledgeable. For more information, visit pinecone.io.

About the Team and Role:

We are hiring a senior/staff software engineer to help design and build core components of our next-generation knowledge retrieval system built for the AI era – search and retrieval infrastructure that powers high-quality, scalable, and enterprise-grade agentic systems. You’ll build the framework that allows our customers to connect knowledge–synthesized from structured and unstructured data–to modern LLM-powered applications, leveraging the world’s best-in-class vector DB supporting semantic search and hybrid retrieval. This role is ideal for someone who loves backend system architecture, distributed systems, and applied AI infrastructure. It is a high impact role with significant ownership across architecture, performance, and system reliability.

Responsibilities:

Design and build scalable platform components leveraging advanced retrieval via query planning, semantic and hybrid search, metadata-aware search, and LLM generation
Design and build optimized indexing pipelines for structured and unstructured data
Build backend services for semantic and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graph construction, and retrieval orchestration
Improve retrieval quality through evaluation and observability frameworks
Design APIs for internal and external user and agentic consumers
Optimize latency, throughput and cost across large-scale inference and retrieval workloads
Drive technical direction for reliability and security

What You’ll Bring to the Table:

To thrive in this role, you don't need to check every single box, but you should be deeply passionate about how to turn data into knowledge.

Systems Expertise

Architectural Depth: You have a proven track record (typically 6+ years) of shipping production-grade backends for large-scale systems. You don’t just write code; you design for high throughput, low latency, and long-term maintainability.
Data Engineering Savvy: You’re comfortable building high-throughput indexing pipelines that handle both the messy world of unstructured data and the rigid world of structured schemas.

AI & Retrieval

Retrieval Intuition: You understand that "search" is more than just a keyword match. You have direct experience (or deep theoretical knowledge) in semantic search, vector databases, hybrid retrieval strategies, or with traditional search engines like Elastic or OpenSearch.
RAG & Orchestration: You understand the nuances of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, from embedding pipelines and hybrid search techniques to how query planning and metadata filtering can make or break an LLM's performance.

Technical

Language Fluency: You are an expert in at least one major language like Go, Rust, C++, Java, or Python.
Infrastructure: Familiarity and experience with modern infrastructure tools, such as Kubernetes, cloud-native architectures, and observability frameworks, as well as infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

Ownership & Impact

Product Thinking: You don't just build to spec; you build for the user. You can design clean, intuitive APIs that both human developers and autonomous agents will love.
Ambiguity Navigator: You’re comfortable in a high-growth environment. You prefer "owning a problem" over "executing a ticket."

Bonus Points

Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Experience with retrieval evaluation frameworks—knowing how to actually measure "good" search results.
Experience with query planning or agentic reasoning loops (e.g., teaching a system how to break down a complex prompt into multiple specific steps).

jobs.description:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.

AI Fearlessly.

About The Role

We are looking for a Staff Data Engineer – Data Platform
to help design and build the next generation of the Vision One Data Platform
.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role focused on creating a modern data foundation that enables Vision One engineering teams to discover, govern, access, transform, and analyze data across the platform. You will work at the intersection of distributed databases, data engineering, data governance, semantic discovery, and self-service analytics
.

A key part of the role is enabling dbt as a self-service data transformation and modeling capability across Vision One OLTP databases
, while building the underlying architecture, governance, and data movement infrastructure required to do this reliably at scale.

You will work closely with platform, product, security, and data engineering teams to establish common data standards and infrastructure that can be reused across Vision One.

What You’ll Do

Design and build the Vision One Data Platform, including data ingestion, replication, transformation, governance, discovery, and serving capabilities.
Build scalable data pipelines and change-data-capture (CDC) architectures using technologies such as Datastream and similar streaming/replication technologies.
Enable self-service dbt across Vision One OLTP data sources, providing product teams with governed capabilities to transform, model, test, document, and expose their data without requiring the central data platform team to build every pipeline.
Establish patterns for safely extracting and replicating data from OLTP and distributed SQL databases into analytical and downstream data systems.
Design architectures around distributed SQL technologies such as YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, or similar platforms.
Work with technologies such as Databricks and modern analytical processing engines to support large-scale data processing and analytics.
Build a comprehensive data catalog and metadata foundation that enables teams and AI agents to understand what data exists, where it comes from, what it means, and how it can be used.
Develop semantic data discovery capabilities that allow engineers, analysts, applications, and AI agents to discover relevant data based on business meaning rather than only database/schema names.
Establish data governance standards covering ownership, lineage, schemas, quality, access control, retention, and lifecycle management.
Develop reusable data platform primitives and APIs that product teams can consume as self-service capabilities.
Build automated mechanisms for data quality, schema evolution, lineage, observability, and freshness monitoring.
Design for evolving product schemas and ensure the platform can accommodate continuous changes without creating excessive duplication or operational overhead.
Partner with security and platform engineering teams to establish appropriate fine-grained data access controls across databases, schemas, tables, and data products.
Help establish the source-of-truth architecture for Vision One data while minimizing unnecessary data duplication.
Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to other data engineers and product engineering teams.
Drive engineering standards around reliability, scalability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.

Required

What You Bring

8+ years of experience in data engineering, distributed systems, backend engineering, or a related field.
Strong experience designing and building large-scale data platforms and data pipelines.
Deep understanding of OLTP and OLAP architectures and the tradeoffs between them.
Hands-on experience with CDC, data replication, and streaming architectures.
Strong SQL expertise and experience working with relational databases at scale.
Experience with distributed SQL databases, such as YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, Spanner, or similar technologies.
Experience building data transformation workflows using dbt or similar data modeling frameworks.
Experience with modern analytical/data platforms such as Databricks, Spark, Trino, Snowflake, BigQuery, or equivalent.
Strong understanding of data governance concepts including metadata, lineage, data quality, ownership, access control, and data catalogs.
Experience designing systems that support self-service data consumption and transformation.
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including API design, testing, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Ability to work across organizational boundaries and influence architecture and engineering standards without relying solely on formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building a company-wide or platform-level Data Platform rather than individual product pipelines.
Experience with Datastream, Debezium, Kafka, or similar CDC/streaming technologies.
Experience with YugabyteDB or CockroachDB in production environments.
Experience operating Databricks or similar distributed data-processing platforms.
Experience designing data catalogs, semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or ontology-driven data discovery.
Experience building platforms that expose data to AI/agentic applications.
Experience with data mesh, data products, or domain-oriented data architectures.
Experience implementing fine-grained authorization for data platforms.
Experience managing large-scale telemetry, security, observability, or other high-volume data.
Experience balancing data quality, query performance, platform reliability, and infrastructure cost.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will help establish a Data Platform where:

Vision One data can be discovered through a common semantic layer, rather than requiring teams to understand every underlying database and schema.
Product teams can use dbt as a governed self-service capability across their OLTP data.
Data lineage, ownership, quality, and access policies are built into the platform rather than managed manually.
Data can move reliably from distributed OLTP systems into analytical and downstream systems through standardized CDC and streaming patterns.
Product teams can consume platform capabilities without repeatedly building their own ingestion, transformation, governance, and discovery infrastructure.
The platform provides a trusted source of truth while minimizing unnecessary copies of data.
The resulting data foundation can support not only traditional analytics and applications, but also AI and agentic experiences across Vision One.

Engineering Leadership

As a Staff Engineer, you will be expected to operate beyond the boundaries of a single team. You will shape architecture, establish technical standards, mentor engineers, drive cross-team adoption, and solve ambiguous problems that span multiple products and systems.

You should be comfortable going deep into implementation details while simultaneously thinking about the long-term architecture of a large-scale, multi-product security data platform
.

Why Join TrendAI?

TrendAI is a leader in AI security. We not only delivered the first open-weight, cybersecurity-focused large language model, but also the industry's first security companion agent evaluated directly by customers. Trend Vision One integrates endpoint, cloud, network, email, identity, AI application, and data security into a single, unified platform. In this role, you will help define how a security-critical product is built — including how AI shapes the development process itself. You will partner with engineering leaders applying AI to that process, working in an environment where the bar on systems thinking, critical review, and security instinct has gone up, not down.

What We Offer You

You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. TrendAI provides benefit options for you and your family.

Achieving work-life balance is a priority, complemented by team activities, fostering an environment rooted in equity, inclusion, and collaboration, that is reflected in both our culture and our work.
